# RESULTS (generated by `eval/make_results.py` from `results/*.json`)

Synthetic data only: 60 fictional submissions (28 with planted risk), test split = 40 files, frozen
before any LLM run (hash `3e9400c9a45306bd`). Model: Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), effort low.
Dev was used for prompt / agent changes; **test was run once** per component.

## 1 · Intelligent document processing (LLM extraction, prompt v2)
| | test | all 60 |
|---|---|---|
| key fields exactly right | 320 fields, **99.7%** | 99.8% |
| flag quotes found verbatim in the documents | 200/200 | |
| seconds per file (3 PDFs) | | 2.08 |
Rules baseline (regex for the two known forms): test field accuracy 82.8%.

## 2 · Routing: standard review vs refer to a senior underwriter (test, 40 files, 17 risky)
| | rules baseline (no LLM) | LLM extraction + validators + agent |
|---|---|---|
| risky files caught (recall) | 11/17 = 64.7% | 17/17 = **100.0%** |
| refer precision | 100.0% | 94.4% (1 false refer) |
| route accuracy | 85.0% | 97.5% |
| broker/address ring files caught | 0/2 | **2/2** |
| injected-instruction files sent to standard | 0/1 | 0/1 |
| "decline" routes | 0 (no such route) | 0 |
Dev (20 files, after 3 agent iterations): recall 100.0%, precision 100.0%, rings 3/3.
Every referred file stops at a LangGraph `interrupt()` and waits in the human review queue (`/queue`).

## 3 · Cross-file questions: vector RAG vs GraphRAG-style graph retrieval (same model, same answer prompt)
| split | questions | vector RAG (bge-small, top-8) | graph retrieval | difference (95% paired bootstrap CI) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| test | 20 | 5/20 = 25.0% | 19/20 = **95.0%** | +70 pts [+45, +90] |
| dev | 10 | 5/10 | 10/10 | |
By type (test): broker_total_paid vector 0/8 vs graph 8/8, broker_fire_count vector 0/3 vs graph 3/3, shared_mailing vector 3/7 vs graph 7/7, location_to_broker_claims vector 2/2 vs graph 1/2.

## 4 · Cost
All LLM calls in the project, dev iterations included: **375 calls, $0.107** (hard cap $0.50, `results/cost_ledger.jsonl`).

See `FAILURES.md` for what went wrong and what was changed.
